newsitem.title: FRANCE: Channel Tunnel fire repair will take weeks -France.
newsitem.headline: Channel Tunnel fire repair will take weeks -France.

text.p: French Transport Minister Bernard Pons said on Tuesday that it would take several weeks to repair damage to the Channel Tunnel after a fire in a freight train.

"The installations in the tunnel were damaged over almost 600 metres (yards) so that several weeks of work are required," Pons told parliament after the overnight blaze, in which two people were seriously injured and six others taken to hospital.

Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said it hoped to resume partial services later on Tuesday, starting with Eurostar passenger trains between Paris and London and Brussels and London and freight trains.
In the meantime, passengers were being taken to Calais or Folkestone and transported across the Channel by boat or put on Paris-London flights instead.
Pons said the lives of those injured were not in danger after the first serious accident since the rail link opened in 1994. Eurotunnel said all were due to leave hospital on Tuesday.
Pons said an inquiry would check whether tighter security or improved ventilation were needed in the tunnel, designed to withstand everything from earthquakes to guerrilla bombs.
